encode_text_with_sentencepiece: encode a string into sentencepiece subword tokens using SentencepieceBPE
decode_sentencepiece_tokens: decode sentencepiece subword tokens back into a readable string
register_sentencepiece_bpe: register the sentencepiece BPE encoder with fairseq using the register_bpe decorator
add_sentencepiece_args: add the sentencepiece-vocab argument to an argparse parser for SentencepieceBPE
initialize_sentencepiece_processor: initialize a SentencepieceBPE instance by loading a sentencepiece vocab file
